details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~5567-5570, ~5611-5620 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The progress fingerprint used for no_progress detection includes absolute file paths, so identical artifacts on different runs hash differently.
  WHY: GITHUB_RUN_ID changes between runs, so the restored marker and the current run cannot match on fingerprint even when artifact contents are unchanged.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~5524-5673 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The recomputed progress fingerprint omits the artifacts list that was included in the stored marker, so same-head resume can spuriously conclude there was no progress.
  WHY: The restored marker and the recomputation hash different payloads, so the resume loop can stop even after real progress was made.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1942-2095, ~5444-5773 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: completed_scope and incomplete_scope are only written during the partial-finalize path, so interrupted normal runs restore empty scope lists and re-run completed stages.
  WHY: A same-head continuation that never reached partial-finalize loses its progress records, so the resume helpers cannot skip reviewer/consolidator/parser/ledger work.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:149-235 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The pass-1 resume skip checks look for completion markers that nothing writes during normal execution.
  WHY: Since the expected scope values are never populated, pass-1 always reruns after a successful prior pass-1, wasting budget and time.
- scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh:5-184 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Removing the shared budget helper functions breaks the documented helper contract for callers that still source watchdog_helpers.sh.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on runtime impact, but the highest reported severity is major because downstream consumers can lose budget-management behavior or see zeroed values without a deprecation shim.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:216-393 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: CODEX_HEARTBEAT no longer carries the optional budget_elapsed_secs / budget_remaining_secs suffix.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on impact, but the suffix removal breaks the documented budget-metadata contract for parsers and operators that relied on it.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1945-2095 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The restored JSON marker files are read from cache and exported into GITHUB_ENV, creating a low-trust resume input path.
  WHY: Type checks limit the blast radius, but a tampered per-PR cache can still influence resume state.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1970 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Malformed or zero REVIEW_MAX_RESUME_ROUNDS values are silently coerced to 3 instead of being rejected.
  WHY: That hides operator mistakes and can make the effective resume-round cap differ from what was configured.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:510 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The resume-parsing logic is duplicated across multiple scripts and the workflow, so changes can diverge.
  WHY: Divergent parsing or defaults can make one path treat the same resume state as terminal while another treats it as resumable.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1942-2095 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Marker selection uses mtime_ns as a tie-breaker when multiple markers share the same resume_round.
  WHY: On filesystems or cache restores with weak or uniform mtime behavior, selection can become non-deterministic and pick an older marker.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~213-230 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: reviewer_resume_completed_scope_contains splits scope values on raw commas.
  WHY: Any future scope name containing a comma would misparse and break resume decisions.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1945-2095 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Resume helpers look for prior-run reviewer/status/ledger files under a fresh /tmp previous_reviews directory that is not restored automatically.
  WHY: The next run starts with an empty temp directory, so the skip checks always fail and the workflow reruns work instead of resuming it.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~2964-5791 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Pure resume-terminal runs skip all follow-up steps but do not post a PR comment explaining the terminal outcome and remaining scope.
  WHY: The only PR-facing comment step is gated on partial-finalize, so no_progress / round_budget_exhausted exits stay visible only in the job summary.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Persist and restore partial review state keyed by PR number plus head SHA so the next run continues from prior progress instead of restarting from scratch."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml — reviewer, consolidator, parser, and ledger steps
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: No normal-execution step writes completed_scope or incomplete_scope; the only writer is the partial-finalize path.
- requirement: "Add explicit loop-safety guards: bound resume rounds with a new defaulted knob (for example REVIEW_MAX_RESUME_ROUNDS), stop when a round makes no progress"
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh - pass-1 resume skip logic
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: reviewer_resume_can_skip_pass1 checks for reviewers_pass1 / reviewers_pass1_consensus markers, but nothing populates them during normal execution, so pass-1 always reruns.
- requirement: "A no-progress round terminates the cycle without another re-trigger"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, the fingerprint comparison in the "Post partial finalize comment and persist runtime marker" step
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The fingerprint includes absolute file paths containing GITHUB_RUN_ID, which changes between runs, so the no_progress state can never be reached in real CI.
- requirement: "Tests cover resume-state restore, no-progress termination, unchanged-head suppression, and round-budget exhaustion"
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The existing no_progress test passes only because both runs share the same temp directory; a different-temp-dir run would expose the path-in-fingerprint bug.
- requirement: "When the round budget is exhausted, the run ends green/neutral and posts a final summary describing what remains unreviewed."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml — a PR comment step gated on resume-terminal state
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: AUTOFIX_RESUME_TERMINAL skips the follow-up phases, but the only PR-facing comment step is gated on AUTOFIX_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUESTED, so pure terminal-resume runs never post the summary.
- requirement: "Document the resume key, default round bound, and no-progress semantics additively in README.md."
  expected_change_site: README.md section on review pipeline knobs / run summary contract
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The added documentation does not spell out progress_fingerprint, the exact resume key, or the two terminal states that suppress continuation.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: Python heredoc in "Post partial finalize comment and persist runtime marker" step, `describe_path` function (lines ~5567-5570) and the fingerprint computation (lines ~5611-5620)
  Problem: The progress fingerprint used for `no_progress` detection includes `describe_path` entries that embed absolute file paths via `path.as_posix()`.
  Why it fails at runtime: The file paths are under `/tmp/codex-pr-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}-${RANDOM}/`, and `GITHUB_RUN_ID` changes between every workflow run, so the fingerprints will always differ even when every artifact file has identical content.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh
  Line or code reference: `reviewer_resume_should_reuse_success_slot` (lines ~218-224), `reviewer_resume_can_skip_pass1` (lines ~212-217), `reviewer_resume_can_skip_reviewers` (lines ~207-210)
  Problem: These resume helpers check for the existence of status files, reviewer output files, and consensus ledger files under `${PREVIOUS_REVIEWS_DIR}`, but that directory is a fresh `/tmp/codex-pr-<NEW_RUN_ID>-.../previous_reviews` path on the next run.
  Why it fails at runtime: `reviewer_resume_should_reuse_success_slot` always returns false because the prior run's status file does not exist in the new `/tmp/` directory, `reviewer_resume_can_skip_pass1` always returns false because the prior reviewer files are missing, and `reviewer_resume_can_skip_reviewers` always returns false for the same reason.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh
  Line or code reference: Lines 7-184 (removed budget helper functions)
  Problem: The budget helper functions (`normalize_review_soft_deadline_minutes`, `codex_run_budget_initialize`, `codex_run_budget_export`, `codex_run_budget_total_secs`, `codex_run_budget_start_epoch`, `codex_run_budget_soft_deadline_epoch`, `codex_run_budget_elapsed_secs`, `codex_run_budget_remaining_secs`, `codex_run_budget_summary`, `codex_run_budget_phase_may_start`) were removed from `watchdog_helpers.sh`.
  Why it fails at runtime: Does not fail; the `command -v` guards ensure callers silently fall back.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 1
- File: scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh
  Line or code reference: Line 393 (`_emit_wrapper_stderr` call site)
  Problem: The `CODEX_HEARTBEAT` log line no longer includes the optional `budget_elapsed_secs` and `budget_remaining_secs` suffix.
  Why it fails at runtime: Does not fail; the format change stays within the stable prefix contract and the suffix was already optional.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: "Restore same-head partial resume state" step (lines ~1945-2095)
  Problem: The step introduces a Python heredoc that reads JSON files from `.ai/review_runtime/pr-<PR>/round-*/partial_finalize.json` and exports their contents as `GITHUB_ENV` variables.
  Why it fails at runtime: The JSON is type-checked before export, so the risk is low; a malicious cache collision could at worst perturb resume state, but the round-limit validation and filesystem metadata tie-breaker limit the blast radius.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2

- Requirement: "A no-progress round terminates the cycle without another re-trigger" (from issue #3717 acceptance criteria)
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, the fingerprint comparison in the "Post partial finalize comment and persist runtime marker" step
  Evidence of absence: The finger
